updates.sentence: Initial detention following the February 8, 1968 Orangeburg shooting. Released on $20,000 bail before trial; the exact bail-release date remains unverified. The later prison term was served in 1973 and is recorded separately.

entries.rationale: The 1968 arrest was incorrectly joined to a 1973 release, creating an unsupported five-year counter. Contemporary FBI record documents intervening $20,000 bail. Preserve initial arrest/start; clear the unrelated 1973 endpoint.

updates.sentence: One-year sentence; served approximately seven months in 1973 before release. The prison term began in February 1973, after the earlier pretrial release on bail. Pardoned July 20, 1993.

entries.rationale: Mark February 1973 start as month precision, rather than pretending February 1 is known. Contemporary September 1973 report and SNCC history support seven months actually served. Existing August 31 release retained, corroborated by the dated post-release press-conference archive.
